prompt:
A THREE-PANEL horizontal strip: three equal-width panels in one row, separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. One consistent world, one consistent cast, one consistent laptop and one consistent tablet across all three panels, reading left to right as a progression.

THE FIGURES: EXACTLY ONE of each person in frame, never duplicated, and both appear in all three panels. THE OPERATOR is a Black woman in her mid-thirties, short natural hair, a rust-red crewneck sweater, same face and same clothing in every panel. THE CUSTOMER is a white man in his sixties, close-cropped grey beard, an olive canvas jacket over a pale shirt, same face and same clothing in every panel. Their clothes are several shades apart in value and never match.

THE TWO DEVICES ARE SEPARATE AND MUST NEVER BE CONFUSED. The CUSTOMER holds his own flat TABLET in his two hands, angled toward HIS face; it does not glow amber and there are no little figures inside it. The OPERATOR has her own LAPTOP open on the table beside her, lid facing HER, its screen glowing translucent amber with a small rounded commander in a gold military cap and two small agents working inside it. THE CUSTOMER NEVER LOOKS AT, TOUCHES, REACHES FOR, OR SPEAKS TO THE GLOWING LAPTOP IN ANY PANEL. The operator is the only person who deals with it.

BEAT ONE: the two of them sit side by side at a plain wooden table. The customer is working on his tablet, brow furrowed, one finger hovering and hesitating above the same spot. The operator is turned toward HIM and is watching HIS HANDS, saying nothing, her own hands still in her lap. Her laptop sits open beside her, glowing, ignored for this moment.

BEAT TWO: the customer is still on his tablet, still working, not looking up. The operator has turned to her own laptop and is speaking toward it, one hand raised in a small explaining gesture; inside the screen the gold-capped commander and the two agents are pulling apart and rebuilding a small panel of shapes. Her eyes stay angled back toward the customer's tablet even as she speaks to the laptop.

BEAT THREE: the operator says one short thing to the customer and gestures at his tablet; he taps to refresh it and his posture opens, hesitation gone, his finger moving on confidently. Her laptop still glows beside her with the commander inside, and the customer still has not touched it.

Physical relationships that must read correctly: the tablet is a thin separate slab in the customer's hands and the laptop is a separate open object on the table with a keyboard base, so the two are never the same device; the laptop's amber glow falls on the operator's face and her side of the table and does NOT light the customer's tablet; in every panel the customer's body is oriented to his own tablet.

Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, and no other text anywhere in the image:
- In the cream margin ABOVE the panels, a title bar in caps: ITERATE AT THE SPEED OF REVELATION
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER the left panel, in caps: WATCH THEIR HANDS
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER the middle panel, in caps: TELL YOUR AGENTS
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER the right panel, in caps: NOW REFRESH
- In the cream margin BELOW the panels, a footer bar in caps: THEY USE. YOU WATCH. THE AGENTS BUILD.

All other writable surfaces in the scene are BLANK: the tablet screen carries only simple shapes and no lettering, the laptop screen carries only the small figures and simple shapes, and there are no signs, no wall labels, no banners, no papers with writing and no numbers anywhere.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
